meta.title: Kueh Database
meta.description: A dataset of traditional Southeast Asian kueh (Nyonya/Peranakan, Malay, Chinese, Indonesian) for use in interactive projects.

fields.name: common English/Malay name
fields.alt_names: other names/spellings, including origin-language script where relevant
fields.texture: steamed | fried | baked | boiled | raw/uncooked | grilled
fields.color: dominant color(s), useful for UI theming

meta.note: Compiled from general culinary knowledge and public heritage sources (e.g. Johor Kaki blog, SG101 heritage archive). Verify details before publishing as authoritative history.

kueh.name: Ang Ku Kueh
kueh.origin: Hokkien Chinese (Fujian), adopted into Peranakan cuisine
kueh.description: Oval, tortoise-shell-shaped glutinous rice cake with a soft chewy skin, traditionally dyed red and filled with sweet mung bean paste. Used in birthdays and religious offerings.

kueh.name: Ondeh-Ondeh
kueh.description: Pandan-green glutinous rice balls filled with liquid palm sugar, rolled in grated coconut. Bursts with syrup when bitten.

kueh.name: Kueh Lapis
kueh.description: Steamed layered cake, traditionally built up layer by layer in contrasting colors. Eaten by peeling apart each soft, slightly chewy layer.

kueh.name: Kueh Salat
kueh.description: Two-tiered kueh with a base of steamed glutinous rice and a top layer of silky pandan-coconut custard.

kueh.name: Kueh Dadar
kueh.description: Thin pandan-flavored crepe rolled around a sweet coconut and palm sugar filling.

kueh.name: Kueh Bahulu
kueh.description: Small, dense-yet-airy sponge cakes baked in fish or flower-shaped molds, popular during Hari Raya.

kueh.name: Kueh Talam
kueh.description: Two-layered steamed cake, usually a sweet pandan or mung bean base topped with a salty-sweet coconut milk layer.

kueh.name: Kueh Ku
kueh.description: Similar to ang ku kueh but often smaller, softer-skinned, and made in varied colors, pressed with a wooden or plastic mold.

kueh.name: Kueh Pie Tee
kueh.description: Crispy thin pastry cups filled with a savory stir-fried mix of turnip, carrot, and shrimp, garnished fresh at the table.

kueh.name: Kueh Lapis Legit
kueh.description: Rich, buttery spiced layer cake baked one thin layer at a time under a grill, a legacy of Dutch colonial baking traditions.

kueh.name: Putu Piring
alt_names: Steamed Rice Cake with Palm Sugar
kueh.description: Small steamed rice flour discs with a pocket of melted palm sugar inside, served with fresh grated coconut.

kueh.name: Kueh Bingka Ubi
kueh.description: Dense, chewy baked tapioca cake with a caramelized golden crust, similar in spirit to bibingka.

kueh.name: Kueh Koci
kueh.color: white or pink, wrapped in banana leaf
kueh.description: Pyramid-shaped glutinous rice dumpling wrapped in banana leaf, filled with sweet coconut and palm sugar.

kueh.name: Apam Balik
kueh.description: Folded pancake with a crisp, lacy exterior and a soft interior, filled with crushed peanuts and sugar.

kueh.name: Kueh Tutu
kueh.description: Small steamed rice flour cakes pressed in a mold and steamed over a pandan leaf, giving a fragrant aroma; filled with ground peanut or palm sugar.

kueh.name: Kueh Kosui
kueh.description: Translucent, jelly-like steamed cake made with palm sugar, served in small cups topped with grated coconut.

kueh.name: Kueh Ubi Kayu
kueh.description: Soft, moist steamed cassava cake, mildly sweet, often topped with grated coconut.

kueh.name: Kueh Lopez
kueh.description: Diamond-shaped glutinous rice cake, boiled wrapped in leaves, rolled in coconut, and drizzled with palm sugar syrup.

kueh.name: Curry Puff
kueh.description: Crescent-shaped pastry filled with spiced curried potato and sometimes egg or chicken, a beloved teatime snack.

kueh.name: Otak-Otak
kueh.description: Spiced fish paste wrapped in banana leaf and grilled over charcoal; often grouped with kueh in hawker contexts even though savory.

kueh.name: Pulut Inti
main_ingredients: grated coconut with gula melaka topping
kueh.description: Compressed glutinous rice (sometimes dyed blue with bunga telang) topped with sweet caramelized coconut.

kueh.name: Kueh Cucur
kueh.description: Deep-fried disc of sweetened batter with a crisp edge and soft, spongy, caramel-colored center.
